rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records for the entire import is within threshold.
Validates teachers_and_staff_2010_2014 data against its golden summary report.
Validates teachers_and_staff_2016 data against its golden summary report.
Validates teachers_and_staff_2018_2022 data against its golden summary report.
Verifies that each input contains non-empty data meeting its expected freshness threshold.

params.query: SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(MinDate) <= '2014' AND MAX(MinDate) <= '2014' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2014' WHEN MIN(MinDate) = '2016' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2016' WHEN MAX(MinDate) >= '2018' THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2022' ELSE FALSE END AS is_fresh, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM stats
